title: What Killing a Sin Actually Costs a Godly Man
caption:
Killing a sin isn't a prayer you say once. It's a funeral, and then another one, and then another one after that.

It costs the thing that felt like relief. It costs the excuse you've been running on for years. It costs going first and saying the name of it out loud before you're ready to.

Paul didn't say manage your sin. He said put it to death, and he said it to people who were already trying and still losing some days.

That's not failure. That's the actual fight.
